description: This Java source file defines a ContentProvider named DataProvider for an Android application. It manages two tables: one for storing URLs of Picasa featured pictures and another for tracking the last update times of these URLs. The class includes methods for creating, querying, inserting, bulk inserting, updating, and managing database schema versions.

classes.name: DataProvider
classes.description: A ContentProvider subclass that manages storage and retrieval of picture URLs and their last update times in an SQLite database.

classes.name: DataProvider.DataProviderHelper
classes.description: An inner class extending SQLiteOpenHelper that manages database creation, upgrade, and downgrade.
